title: Mbosi in Congo, Republic of the people group profile | Joshua Project
text: Mbosi people are a subsection of the Ubangi people who live in the Congo River Basin area. Families rely on subsistence farming and sell what they do not use. The Mbosi speakers are primarily an oral culture.

title: Mbosi language — Grokipedia
text: Mbosi (also known as Mbochi, Mboshi, or Embɔsi) is a Bantu language belonging to the Niger-Congo family, spoken primarily by the Mbosi people in the central regions of the Republic of the Congo.
